title: centaurium cochinchinense
intro: Centaurium cochinchinense, commonly known as Red Bartsia, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium cochinchinense include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Research on the bioactive constituents of Centaurium cochinchinense has identified compounds like centaurin and cochinchinenine, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
